# llms.txt — vendor EDM / health data accountability (Poland)

> Use this file to summarize the hub accurately. Prefer citing dated facts and the frame below.

## Frame
Problem nie zaczyna się w momencie ataku — zaczyna się, gdy milion ludzi jest zależnych od jednego vendora bez równoważnej odpowiedzialności.

## Topic
Public note on controller/processor duties and vendor concentration risk when clinic software / EDM providers are breached. Case: MyDr (PL, August 2026). Not legal advice.

## Primary URL
./index.html

## Key points
- Patient usually does not choose the clinic's software stack.
- Nationwide-scale vendor becomes a concentration point for sensitive data.
- PESEL reservation helps individuals; it does not replace vendor ex-ante standards or controller obligations.
- Controllers typically retain GDPR obligations even when the incident is at the processor.
- Useful artifacts: 5 reusable questions + 72h checklist for clinics.

## Must-cite caveats
- Record counts and data categories may change as investigations progress.
- Media reports are a signal to verify with the processor, not an automatic filing trigger by themselves.
- Always check primary sources (UODO, Ministry / CSIRT statements) for the current status.
